mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate hiring and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness that lowers corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing industrial production growth below 0.5% annually signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO growth below 0.5%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that triggers Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation increase and federal funds rate decline signal policy uncertainty that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPI rising and FEDFUNDS falling, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth above 3.0% annualized in late-cycle expansion signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 growth above 3.0%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
